The full documentation can be found at [[tw-mcp plugin|https://wikilabs.github.io/editions/tw-mcp/]] main page. ''Since v0.14.0'' most tool handlers live in the separate [[tw-mcp-core|$:/plugins/wikilabs/tw-mcp-core]] plugin; this one keeps the transports and the node-only tools. Install BOTH plugins. ---- ''Important'': This plugin ships {{{ [[$:/plugins/wikilabs/tw-mcp]plugintiddlers[]prefix[$:/core/]count[]] }}} tiddlers in the `$:/core/` namespace. They are new modules, except where marked: that one replaces a tiddler ~TiddlyWiki ships.
''The tiddlers'' <$list filter="[[$:/plugins/wikilabs/tw-mcp]plugintiddlers[]prefix[$:/core/]]"><$link to=<>><$text text=<>/><$list filter="[[$:/core]plugintiddlers[]match]" variable="ignore"> ''replaces a core tiddler''
